questions.question_text:
An angle is a little more than half a right angle.
Which estimate is most reasonable?

options.why: This is slightly less than half a right angle, not more.
This is more than a whole right angle, not half of one.
This is an obtuse angle far beyond the stated benchmark.

questions.solution_text: Half of $90^{\circ}$ is $45^{\circ}$, so a little more is about $50^{\circ}$.
